role: ordered construction, sandbox, provenance and reasoning policy for the local CACE hybrid AI
invariant: The local AI is built only after CACE Build Lite, code-builder/bug-sweep tooling, and the hardened sandbox/runtime boundary are complete enough to constrain it.

required_build_order.name: CACE Build Lite
exit_criteria: deterministic changed-path/dependency/critical-path planning works
exact-content cache policy is enforced
proof-sensitive cache hits remain restore-only
builder can consume compact JSON plans

required_build_order.name: Code-builder + helper-tool + bug-sweep layer
exit_criteria: AGENTS/code-builder bootstrap is authoritative
unknown features use ranked implementation alternatives rather than silent omission
custom helper tools are typed, least-privilege and regression-tested
root-cause + sibling sweep + permanent guard workflow is available

required_build_order.name: Hardened self-sandboxing local/private runtime
exit_criteria: browser sees only web gateway
AI process has no direct proof/evidence/wallet authority
network is default-deny and capability-gated
filesystem is scoped/read-only where practical
resource limits and kill controls are enforced
model/observer workers run under separate least-privilege identities
secrets remain outside model context

required_build_order.name: Local hybrid deep AI
exit_criteria: model can run fully local/offline by default
neural generation is mediated by deterministic typed tools
operator/mathematical planner and checker are separate from free-form generation
retrieval/memory is local and provenance-aware
AI output has zero evidence/proof authority
paired intervention and invariance evaluations pass defined thresholds

required_build_order.name: Reasoning curriculum and specialization
exit_criteria: procedural operator curriculum exists
load-bearing perturbation pairs are evaluated
irrelevant perturbations preserve answers
unseen compositions and relabel/coordinate transforms are tested
specialists can be trained/evaluated without weakening sandbox controls

required_build_order.name: Canvas + heartbeat + user controls
exit_criteria: AI context is typed and node-addressed
heartbeat/attention cannot promote verification state
user can disable AI
high-capability/network permissions remain separate opt-ins

hybrid_architecture.principle: Use multiple small, inspectable reasoning components rather than granting one opaque model broad authority.

components.role: natural-language interpretation, summarization and proposal generation
select/compose explicit operations over typed CACE objects
components.authority: may propose executable plans; cannot mark evidence
tool invocation only through capability policy

components.role: retrieve local project/user-approved knowledge with provenance
small domain-specific neural models for bounded tasks
components.authority: advisory/predictive according to module evidence class

components.role: independently verify executable invariants, tests, simulations and formal claims
components.authority: checker result remains distinct from AI confidence

components.role: choose next training/evaluation tasks based on measured weaknesses
route attention and spare compute using non-evidentiary activity state
optional host-owned hidden-layer observation for instrumentable local models

public_methodology_rule.principle: Use only independently implemented general ideas and components with verified rights/provenance. Public availability alone is not legal clearance.
specifically_allowed_as_inspiration: paired canonical/perturbed evaluation where a load-bearing change should change the answer
compact specialist models for bounded domains
contrastive/self-supervised representation learning using independently designed objectives
multi-agent or ensemble disagreement checks with bounded roles

public_inspiration_only: publicly described paired perturbation/flip-style evaluation concept
generic idea of geometric representations for reasoning evaluation/research
sophontic_boundary.naming_rule: CACE uses its own names such as Paired Intervention Consistency; do not market a Sophontic-branded method as CACE.

provenance_gate: classify as general idea, internally derived method, public-domain/CC0, or permissively licensed implementation
preserve attribution/license notices whenever the actual license requires them
do not assume public web publication means patent-free, copyright-free, or attribution-free
for commercially important copied implementations or unusually specific methods, require separate IP/license/patent review before shipping
public_methodology_rule.zero_attribution_preference: If the product specifically requires no attribution obligation for a component, prefer internally authored implementations or materials whose license/provenance explicitly permits that use; do not strip required notices.

sandbox.default_filesystem: read-only model/runtime plus explicit scoped writable workspace
sandbox.default_worker_spawn: off unless host scheduler authorizes a bounded worker
sandbox.model_weight_update: only in explicit training sandbox with signed/versioned output promoted by host review

evaluation.rule: Evaluate externally observable behavior and checkable intermediate objects; never require disclosure of hidden chain-of-thought.

production_rule: No networked/economic/high-capability AI mode may be enabled merely because the local hybrid model exists. Those remain independent user/admin capability gates.
